pre_caption:
This video clip features a slow pan across a desolate, arid landscape under a clear blue sky.

The scene is dominated by a barren, sandy foreground littered with the splintered wooden remains of collapsed structures, scattered debris, and several utility poles. The entire scene is set against a backdrop of a long range of brown, rocky mountains. The overall impression is one of abandonment and decay.
